subject: harness: the checkpoint advisory promises exactly what the prune removes
prompt:
`rune doctor` promises more than `rune doctor prune-checkpoints` delivers. On a real database the doctor printed "552 superseded or orphaned rows, 136 MB — rune doctor prune-checkpoints", and that command then offered to remove 428 rows / 106 MB.

The report (`reportCheckpoints` in packages/shared/src/state.ts) counts a checkpoint row as reclaimable when ANY newer version of the same run exists, while the prune (`pruneCheckpoints`) keeps the newest versions of each run (two by default) and removes only what is older than those.

What should happen: the rows and bytes the report calls reclaimable are exactly the rows and bytes `pruneCheckpoints` would remove with the same keep count, both at the default keep and at any other keep count. Rows whose session is gone still count as reclaimable in both, as they do today.

Keep the existing exported APIs working, and keep the existing tests passing.

Interface the fix must provide:
- `reportCheckpoints(db, keep?)` accepts an optional keep count. With no count it uses the same default `pruneCheckpoints` uses, and `reportCheckpoints(db, n).reclaimableRows` / `.reclaimableBytes` equal `pruneCheckpoints(db, { keep: n })`'s `removedRows` / `removedBytes`.
